metadata.reference_highlights:
Two incisors found in northern Italy have been confirmed to belong to modern humans who were part of the Protoaurignacian culture in Europe .
These people had sophisticated tool making, early art and wore ornaments .
Their arrival in southern Europe coincided with demise of the Neanderthals .
Researchers used CT scanning and DNA analysis to identify origin of teeth .
